title: Hyphen groups to dot groups
description: One-property twin: every hyphen inside the authored value becomes a dot, nothing else changes. The twin of an authored valid value whose separator differs. Skipped when the value has no hyphen.

expectation.basis: The perturbed value is no longer an authored value, and no authored Case states the outcome for this exact perturbation, so the rule asserts only the weakest outcome (identity not-established, sensitivity context-dependent) and flags the fixture derivedFromRule. It makes no positional claim: no span is emitted.

title: Zero-width space inside the value
description: One-property mutation: U+200B is inserted after the first code point of the authored value, nothing else changes. The inserted character is invisible and carries no identifier content.

title: ASCII letters to upper case
description: One-property mutation: ASCII letters of the authored value become upper case, no locale, nothing else changes. Skipped when the value is already upper case.
